caption: 选择收益上限的互补性审计（开发侧）。(a) 单一最好配置（SBS，平均惩罚成本比最低）相对逐实例最好（VBS）的平均成本差，误差线为按田块/底本自助法 95% 区间，横轴为对数；(b) 只有非 SBS 配置能通过独立验算的实例比例。成本比以每个实例的最好可行成本为 1，未通过验算记惩罚值 2；无任何配置可行的实例不计入成本差。
Fields2Cover 配置在荷兰开发田块上的可行率（按机具分组）。柱为各配置通过足迹、采样曲率与内缩区覆盖≥90% 检查的比例，虚线为任一配置可行（VBS）的比例；共 388 个田块×机具实例。现行默认配置（牛耕分解·最少作业行）可行 254 个。
覆盖配置对逐实例最好组合的贡献。v(S) 为实例平均的 [2 − min_{a∈S} ρ]；Shapley 值按全部子集精确计算（Fréchette 等 2016），边际贡献为从完整组合移除该配置后的价值损失。边际贡献接近零而 Shapley 值不为零表示与其他配置可相互替代。
尝试顺序与可行率。曲线为在全体开发数据上按边际收益贪心排列的固定顺序（描述性，非留出评价）；散点为分组交叉验证中各策略得到首个可行路径所需的平均尝试次数（留出田块）。
先测后学（prequential）评价：按 20 个随机田块顺序逐块处理，每块先用当前策略决定尝试顺序并记账，再把该田块的全部结果加入经验库。前 10 块使用冷启动顺序（现行默认优先），竖虚线后启用学习策略。实线为均值，阴影为第 10–90 百分位。
实例空间（农业结构特征的主成分投影，Smith-Miles 实例空间分析的线性简化）。颜色/标记为该实例上成本比最低的配置，× 为没有任何配置通过独立验算的实例。
执行反馈信号：26 场成功田间仿真中 66 台次车辆的规划用时与仿真驾驶用时（已扣除串行预约的排队等待）。驾驶/规划比中位数 1.079，第 10–90 百分位 1.025–1.218；会话含同一方案的重复执行，不同方案 10 个。差值来自加减速、转向与跟踪，是执行反馈学习要校正的对象；样本量小，仿真结果不外推为实车。

Complementarity audit of the selection headroom (development data). (a) Mean cost excess of the single best configuration (SBS, lowest mean penalised ratio) over the per-instance best (VBS), with field/base-instance bootstrap 95% intervals, log scale; (b) share of instances that only non-SBS configurations solve under the independent checker. Ratios are relative to the best feasible cost per instance; failures count as 2; unsolved instances are excluded from (a).

Feasibility of Fields2Cover configurations on the Dutch development fields by machine profile. Bars: share passing the footprint, sampled-curvature and ≥90% inner-coverage checks; dashed lines: share solved by any configuration (VBS); 388 field × profile instances. The current default (boustrophedon decomposition, fewest swaths) is feasible on 254.

Contributions of coverage configurations to the per-instance-best portfolio. v(S) is the instance mean of [2 − min_{a∈S} ρ]; Shapley values are exact over all subsets (Fréchette et al. 2016); the marginal contribution is the loss when the configuration is removed from the full portfolio. A near-zero marginal contribution with a non-zero Shapley value indicates substitutability.

Try-order and feasibility. The curve is a fixed order chosen greedily on all development data (descriptive, not held out); markers give the mean number of tries to the first feasible path for each policy under field-grouped cross-validation (held-out fields).

Prequential (test-then-train) evaluation over 20 random field orders: each field is first decided by the current policy and scored, then all of its results enter the experience base. The first 10 fields use the cold-start order (current default first); learned policies start after the dotted line. Lines: mean; bands: 10th–90th percentiles.

Instance space (principal components of the agricultural features; a linear simplification of Smith-Miles instance space analysis). Colour/marker: configuration with the lowest ratio on the instance; ×: no configuration passes the independent checker.

Execution-feedback signal: planned duration versus simulated driving time (serial-reservation queue waits removed) for 66 vehicle runs in 26 successful field simulations. Median driving/planned ratio 1.079 (10th–90th percentile 1.025–1.218); sessions repeat plans (10 distinct). The gap comes from acceleration, turning and tracking and is what execution-feedback learning must correct; small sample, not extrapolated to real vehicles.
